description: This file implements a test client for MeshAgent communication, supporting both Unix domain sockets and message queues. It includes message definitions, socket/queue setup, message handling, and threading for sending and receiving messages.

methods.name: msgQClient
methods.description: Receives messages from MeshAgent via socket or message queue, parses and logs them.

methods.name: msgQTest
methods.description: Provides a user interface to send predefined messages to MeshAgent.

methods.name: Client_Init
methods.description: Initializes message handling threads for communication with MeshAgent.
